exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect simple or present perfect continuous. (A Canadian actor)
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va qavsdagi fe'llarni present perfect simple yoki present perfect continuous shakliga qo'ying. (Kanadalik aktyor)
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT SIMPLE vs
  CONTINUOUS (coursebook 51-bet).

  SIMPLE (has + V3) - NATIJA,
  NEChTA, TUGALLANGAN:
    'has always made people laugh'
    'has made many films' (nechta)
    'has played serious roles'
  CONTINUOUS (has been + V-ing) -
  DAVOMIYLIK, JARAYON:
    'has been working since 15'
    'has been performing for years'
    'has been living in LA'
    'has been practising lately'

  ⚠ 'since', 'for many years',
  'lately' + jarayon → continuous.
  ⚠ 'many films' (natija/son) →
  simple.


⚠ JAVOB (13b): JIM CARREY -
  'Ace Ventura', 'The Mask', 'The
  Truman Show' - kanadalik aktyor
  (32-betdagi A surat).


⚠ 'A CHILDHOOD':

  = bolalik.


⚠ 'TO PERFORM ON THE STAGE':

  = sahnada chiqish qilmoq.


⚠ 'WITHOUT DOUBT':

  = shubhasiz.


⚠ 'LATELY':

  = so'nggi paytlarda.


⚠ 'TALENTED':

  = iste'dodli.

items.textEn: He had a difficult childhood, but this Canadian actor ___ (always/make) people laugh.
He ___ (work) in comedy since he was fifteen
and ___ (perform) on the stage for many years.
he ___ (make) many very successful comedy films, including Ace Ventura: Pet Detective, Dumb and Dumber and The Mask.
However, he ___ (play) some serious roles too, such as Truman in The Truman Show.
Lately, he ___ (practise) his singing for a new film about the Beatles. He is, without doubt, a very talented man.

  32-betdagi 12-mashq A surati.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing words from the list below: write, aspirin, wrist, hurts, sprained. Then, act out the dialogue in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi tushib qolgan so'zlarni qo'ying: write, aspirin, wrist, hurts, sprained. So'ng dialogni juftlikda ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
ShIFOKORDA - JAROHAT.

  'broken my WRIST' - bilak
  'Can you move it?' - qimirlata
    olasizmi? (sinmagan belgisi)
  'You have SPRAINED it' - chiqarib
    olgansiz
  'Can I still WRITE?' - yoza
    olamanmi?
  'It really HURTS!' - qattiq
    og'riyapti
  'take some ASPIRIN' - aspirin
    iching


⚠ BROKEN vs SPRAINED:

  broken = singan (qimirlatib
  bo'lmaydi)
  sprained = chiqqan (qimirlaydi,
  lekin og'riydi)


⚠ 'TO REST IT':

  = unga dam bermoq.


⚠ 'AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE':

  = iloji boricha ko'p.


⚠ 'TO STOP THE PAIN':

  = og'riqni to'xtatmoq.

exercises.instructionUz: 17-may ... Aziz Elayn, ... Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Kerol
exercises.explanationUz:
BAXTSIZ HODISA HAQIDA XAT -
  KAROL KASALXONADA.

TUZILISh (4 xatboshi):
  1 Yozish sababi (qayerda, nima
    bo'lgan)
  2 Hodisa tafsilotlari (qachon,
    qayerda, qanday)
  3 Hodisadan keyin (kasalxona,
    davolash)
  4 Yakuniy so'zlar (savol, iltimos)


⚠ 'GUESS WHAT?':

  = Bilasanmi nima bo'ldi? (xabar
  oldidan).


⚠ 'A WARD':

  = palata (kasalxona bo'limi).


⚠ 'IN A HURRY':

  = shoshib.


⚠ 'AN X-RAY':

  = rentgen.


⚠ 'IN PLASTER':

  = gipsda.


⚠ 'NOT ALLOWED TO':

  = ... ga ruxsat yo'q.


⚠ 'AWFUL':

  = dahshatli, juda yomon.


⚠ 'HOW ARE THINGS WITH YOU?':

  = Ishlaring qalay?


⚠ 'BEST WISHES' O'RNIGA:

  Love, / Yours, / All the best, /
  Take care, / Lots of love,
  (7-betdagi 16c mashqni eslang).

points.en: Guess what? I'm in hospital! I'm in the Royal General, in ward 4 and I've been here since Saturday. I've broken my leg - but don't worry, I'm okay.
points.uz: Bilasanmi nima bo'ldi? Men kasalxonadaman! Royal General kasalxonasida, 4-palatadaman va shanbadan beri shu yerdaman. Oyog'imni sindirdim - lekin xavotir olma, yaxshiman.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 1 - yozish sababi (reason for writing).
⚠ Present perfect: 'I've been here since', 'I've broken'.

points.en: It happened on Saturday night outside the fish and chip shop in Rose Square. I was in a hurry and I ran down some steps. There was some oil on the steps, but I didn't see it so I slipped and fell.
points.uz: Bu shanba kechasi Rose maydonidagi baliq va kartoshka do'koni oldida sodir bo'ldi. Shoshib turgan edim va zinalardan yugurib tushdim. Zinalarda moy bor edi, lekin ko'rmadim, shuning uchun sirpanib yiqildim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 - hodisa tafsilotlari (details of the accident).
⚠ Past simple: happened, was, ran, didn't see, slipped, fell.

points.en: I was lucky that my parents were with me. They took me straight to the hospital. I had an X-ray and the doctor said my leg was broken. Now it is in plaster and I'm not allowed to move it. The doctors and nurses have been very kind, but the food here is awful! Anyway, they've said I can go home tomorrow or the next day.
points.uz: Ota-onam men bilan bo'lgani omad edi. Ular meni to'g'ri kasalxonaga olib borishdi. Rentgen qildim va shifokor oyog'im singanini aytdi. Endi u gipsda va uni qimirlatishga ruxsat yo'q. Shifokor va hamshiralar juda mehribon, lekin bu yerdagi ovqat dahshatli! Nima bo'lganda ham, ertaga yoki indinga uyga ketishim mumkinligini aytishdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 3 - hodisadan keyin (after the accident).
⚠ 'straight to' = to'g'ri ... ga.

points.en: How are things with you? I hope you're well. Can you send me a nice long letter, or phone me when I get home?
points.uz: Ishlaring qalay? Yaxshi yuribsan deb umid qilaman. Menga uzun chiroyli xat yubora olasanmi yoki uyga qaytganimda qo'ng'iroq qil?

points.noteUz: ⚠ O'rniga: Love, / Yours, / All the best, / Take care,

items.answer: She is in hospital - in the Royal General, in ward 4.

items.question: Why is she in hospital?
items.answer: Because she has broken her leg.

items.question: How did the accident happen?
items.answer: She was in a hurry and ran down some steps outside the fish and chip shop. There was some oil on the steps, she didn't see it, so she slipped and fell.

items.question: What happened at the hospital?
items.answer: She had an X-ray and the doctor said her leg was broken. Now it is in plaster and she isn't allowed to move it.

items.question: When can she go home?
items.answer: She can go home tomorrow or the next day.
items.whyUz: Para 3: 'I can go home tomorrow or the next day'.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to write a letter to your pen-friend explaining what happened (100 - 150 words). Use the letter in Ex. 15 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalar bilan qalamkash do'stingizga nima bo'lganini tushuntirib xat yozing (100-150 so'z). 15-mashqdagi xatdan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT - QO'LNI KUYDIRISh.

REJA (15-mashq):
  Dear + ism,
  1 Guess what? I'm in hospital!
    (City General, ward 17, since
    Sunday; scalded arm)
  2 It happened on Sunday morning
    ... (oshxona, suv, idish)
  3 I was lucky ... (singlim,
    kasalxona, shifokor, bint)
  4 I hope you and your family are
    well. Write soon ...
  Best wishes / Love, + ism

  ⚠ ZAMONLAR: Para 1 - present
  perfect; Para 2 - past simple;
  Para 3 - past simple + present.
  ⚠ 100-150 so'z.

structure.modelEn: Dear Sam, Guess what? I'm in hospital! I'm in the City General, in ward 17 and I've been here since Sunday. I've scalded my arm - but don't worry, I'm okay.
structure.modelUz: Aziz Sem, Bilasanmi nima bo'ldi? Men kasalxonadaman! City General kasalxonasida, 17-palatadaman va yakshanbadan beri shu yerdaman. Qo'limni kuydirdim - lekin xavotir olma, yaxshiman.

structure.modelEn: It happened on Sunday morning in the kitchen at home. I was boiling some water when the pan fell off the stove and all the water went on my arm.
structure.modelUz: Bu yakshanba ertalab uyda, oshxonada sodir bo'ldi. Suv qaynatayotgan edim, idish plitadan tushib ketdi va butun suv qo'limga to'kildi.

structure.modelEn: I was lucky that my sister was with me. She took me straight to the hospital. The doctor examined my arm and said it was badly scalded. Now it is in a bandage and I'm not allowed to get it wet. The doctors and nurses have been very nice. They've said I can go home tomorrow.
structure.modelUz: Singlim men bilan bo'lgani omad edi. U meni to'g'ri kasalxonaga olib bordi. Shifokor qo'limni tekshirib, qattiq kuyganini aytdi. Endi u bintlangan va uni ho'llashga ruxsat yo'q. Shifokor va hamshiralar juda yaxshi. Ertaga uyga ketishim mumkinligini aytishdi.

structure.modelEn: I hope you and your family are well. Write soon and tell me all your news. Best wishes, Anna
structure.modelUz: Sen va oilang yaxshi deb umid qilaman. Tez orada yoz va barcha yangiliklaringni ayt. Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan, Anna

modelAnswers:
20th May, ...

Dear Sam,

Guess what? I'm in hospital! I'm in the City General, in ward 17 and I've been here since Sunday. I've scalded my arm - but don't worry, I'm okay.

It happened on Sunday morning in the kitchen at home. I was boiling some water when the pan fell off the stove and all the water went on my arm.

I was lucky that my sister was with me. She took me straight to the hospital. The doctor examined my arm and said it was badly scalded. Now it is in a bandage and I'm not allowed to get it wet. The doctors and nurses have been very nice. They've said I can go home tomorrow.

I hope you and your family are well. Write soon and tell me all your news.

Best wishes,
Anna
modelAnswersUz:
20-may, ...

Aziz Sem,

Bilasanmi nima bo'ldi? Men kasalxonadaman! City General kasalxonasida, 17-palatadaman va yakshanbadan beri shu yerdaman. Qo'limni kuydirdim - lekin xavotir olma, yaxshiman.

Bu yakshanba ertalab uyda, oshxonada sodir bo'ldi. Suv qaynatayotgan edim, idish plitadan tushib ketdi va butun suv qo'limga to'kildi.

Singlim men bilan bo'lgani omad edi. U meni to'g'ri kasalxonaga olib bordi. Shifokor qo'limni tekshirib, qattiq kuyganini aytdi. Endi u bintlangan va uni ho'llashga ruxsat yo'q. Shifokor va hamshiralar juda yaxshi. Ertaga uyga ketishim mumkinligini aytishdi.

Sen va oilang yaxshi deb umid qilaman. Tez orada yoz va barcha yangiliklaringni ayt.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Anna
